verdict_reason: The role and searchRole filters are wired correctly and tested, but the Operator-to-Address rename left every @Timed metric name on the old concept.

todos.issue: The Operator-to-Address rename stops part-way: every @Timed metric still names the old concept (controller.listOperators.time :110, controller.createOperator.time :233, controller.getOperator.time :284, controller.updateOperator.time :350, controller.deleteOperator.time :397), as does the sibling timer controller.listOperators.query.time in AddressService.java:80. The class, service, mapper, responses and path variable are all Address now, so the metrics are the only place an operator still appears and a reader of a dashboard cannot map them to this API.
todos.fix: Must: every metric this controller and AddressService emit names the address concept, so one concept has one name from path to metric. One way: rename to controller.listAddresses.time, controller.createAddress.time, controller.getAddress.time, controller.updateAddress.time, controller.deleteAddress.time and controller.listAddresses.query.time, and update any Grafana dashboard or alert that queries the old names in the same change (none found in the workspace).
